## AI dashcam video solutions

**Protect your drivers and your bottom line with intelligent video analytics**

Unseen road hazards, distracted driving habits, and false insurance claims put your drivers and your
operational budget at constant risk. Standard telematics can show you where a vehicle is, but it
cannot protect you from the hidden costs and liability of a critical road incident.
* Utilize dual-facing, AI-integrated fleet dashcams for distracted driving detection that
  immediately flags phone use, tiredness, and dangerous habits right when they happen
* Reinforce long-term driver behavior improvement by giving your operators the tools to correct
  driving habits in the moment with proactive in-cab audible notifications
* Reduce costly liability from false claims by deploying Extended View Cameras that offer near
  360-degree clarity alongside forward-facing evidence to establish the facts

simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations.

All data transfer between Ivideon Cloud components and between Ivideon Cloud and end users is

Customer service engineers and other employees can access user channels only with the express

## About HOVST

HOVST develops wireless remote control solutions for industrial equipment and mobile hydraulic
machinery. Our systems help operators work from a safer position while maintaining precise control
of the equipment they rely on every day.

From truck-mounted cranes and log loaders to dump trailers, tarp systems, overhead cranes, and
concrete pump trucks, HOVST remote controls are designed around real operating conditions, clear
control logic, and dependable machine response.

Whether you are retrofitting a manual hydraulic valve bank, replacing an outdated control system, or
integrating a remote solution into new equipment, HOVST provides practical control architectures
built for the application rather than a one-size-fits-all setup.

Our focus is straightforward: give operators more freedom of movement, give equipment owners better
control options, and make demanding industrial work safer, more efficient, and easier to manage.


## Safe radio remote controls

Safety is built into every HOVST remote control system. From control logic and emergency-stop
functions to rugged enclosures and dependable wireless performance, every detail is designed to help
operators work with greater confidence in demanding industrial environments.

Our products are also made for real jobsite conditions. They may be dropped, exposed to rain,
covered in dust, or used day after day around heavy equipment. That is exactly what they are
designed for: reliable control that keeps working when the environment is anything but gentle.


## Why remote control?

A wireless remote control gives operators safer, more flexible control of machinery by freeing them
from the fixed position of a control panel or wired pendant. Instead of working where the controls
happen to be, the operator can move to the position with the clearest view of the load, machine, and
surrounding work area.

Removing the cable also helps reduce everyday jobsite risks. A wired pendant can restrict movement,
snag on equipment, create a trip hazard, or become damaged during normal use. With a wireless
industrial remote, operators have more freedom to work efficiently while keeping clear of
unnecessary cables.

## About HOVST

HOVST develops wireless remote control solutions for industrial equipment and mobile hydraulic
machinery. Our systems help operators work from a safer position while maintaining precise control
of the equipment they rely on every day.

From truck-mounted cranes and log loaders to dump trailers, tarp systems, overhead cranes, and
concrete pump trucks, HOVST remote controls are designed around real operating conditions, clear
control logic, and dependable machine response.

Whether you are retrofitting a manual hydraulic valve bank, replacing an outdated control system, or
integrating a remote solution into new equipment, HOVST provides practical control architectures
built for the application rather than a one-size-fits-all setup.

Our focus is straightforward: give operators more freedom of movement, give equipment owners better
control options, and make demanding industrial work safer, more efficient, and easier to manage.


## Safe radio remote controls

Safety is built into every HOVST remote control system. From control logic and emergency-stop
functions to rugged enclosures and dependable wireless performance, every detail is designed to help
operators work with greater confidence in demanding industrial environments.

Our products are also made for real jobsite conditions. They may be dropped, exposed to rain,
covered in dust, or used day after day around heavy equipment. That is exactly what they are
designed for: reliable control that keeps working when the environment is anything but gentle.


## Why remote control?

A wireless remote control gives operators safer, more flexible control of machinery by freeing them
from the fixed position of a control panel or wired pendant. Instead of working where the controls
happen to be, the operator can move to the position with the clearest view of the load, machine, and
surrounding work area.

Removing the cable also helps reduce everyday jobsite risks. A wired pendant can restrict movement,
snag on equipment, create a trip hazard, or become damaged during normal use. With a wireless
industrial remote, operators have more freedom to work efficiently while keeping clear of
unnecessary cables.

# Home

Auto Theft Prevention

Auto theft is a growing problem across Niagara. 

For information on how to help protect your vehicle,

keep your belongings safe, and what to do if your vehicle

is stolen, please visit our [Auto Theft Preventio][82][n][83] page.

[ Auto Theft Prevention ][84]

NRPS Traffic Hotline

The traffic hotline is a direct line that allows individuals to leave information about 
areas where there are road safety concerns. These can include speed related issues
or other Highway Traffic Act violations, where a greater police presence is required.

To report a concern, call: 289-248-1060

Please note, this does not replace emergency services or collision reporting.
In case of emergency, please call 911. 

Considering a Career in Policing?

We're always looking for qualified individuals to join our Service. 

To learn more about requirements, qualifications,

and the application process, visit our recruiting page.

[ Learn More ][85]

Neighbourhood Watch Program

Neighbourhood Watch is about neighbours looking out for neighbours.  The Niagara Regional Police
Service supports community-led initiatives that promote awareness, reporting, and prevention while
ensuring safety and accountability. 

Neighbourhood Watch is primarily an online platform for communities to share information, look out
for one another and help mitigate risks in their communities.

[ Neighbourhood Watch ][86]

Community Safety Survey

The Niagara Police Service Board, in collaboration with the Niagara Regional Police Service
are asking residents to help shape the future of community safety by participating in a new
Community Safety Survey aimed at identifying community priorities and opportunities to strengthen
policing and public safety across Niagara.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.
